name: Kaleshwaram Project Evaluation Dataset
description: Sample evaluation test questions for the Kaleshwaram Project audit documents

tests.name: Kaleshwaram Project Overview
tests.query: What is the Kaleshwaram Project and what is its main purpose?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks from the executive summary and introduction chapters

tests.name: Project Cost
tests.query: What was the total estimated cost of the Kaleshwaram Project?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks mentioning project budget and financial details

tests.name: Audit Findings
tests.query: What were the main audit findings in the Kaleshwaram Project report?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks from the audit framework and findings sections

tests.name: Project Timeline
tests.query: When was the Kaleshwaram Project initiated and what was the expected completion timeline?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks with timeline and scheduling information

tests.name: Technical Specifications
tests.query: What are the technical specifications of the Kaleshwaram Project irrigation system?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks with technical details about the project

tests.name: Re-engineering
tests.query: What re-engineering changes were made to the PCSS Project?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks from the re-engineering chapter

tests.name: Planning Phase
tests.query: How was the planning phase for the Kaleshwaram Project conducted?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks from the planning chapter

tests.name: Execution Phase
tests.query: What challenges were faced during the execution of the Kaleshwaram Project?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks from the execution chapter

tests.name: Performance Audit
tests.query: What does the performance audit reveal about the project's efficiency?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks from performance audit sections

tests.name: Recommendations
tests.query: What recommendations were made in the audit report for the Kaleshwaram Project?
tests.notes: Should retrieve chunks with recommendations and conclusions

instructions.setup: To use this dataset, you need to first upload the Kaleshwaram Project documents to the system, then populate the expectedChunkIds for each test by running the queries and manually verifying which chunks contain the correct answers.
instructions.usage: Use the Evaluation page in the UI to import these tests and run evaluation runs to measure retrieval performance.
instructions.expectedChunkIds: The expectedChunkIds array should be populated with the actual chunk IDs from your database after document upload and chunking. These represent the ground truth for evaluation metrics.
